text: dsh-skill-manage 是面向 DSH 的技能管理插件，通过注册 skill_manage 工具和系统提示词中的技能纪律段落，让 agent 在会话中维护可热加载的流程技能。工具支持创建、补丁修改、完整编辑、列出、禁用或启用、固定或取消固定技能，并管理受限目录中的辅助文件；删除仅允许带 agent 创建标记且未固定的技能。技能可保存于用户级或项目级目录，适合希望把已验证工作流程沉淀为可复用技能的 DSH 使用者。插件从 DSH_HOME 或主目录定位用户技能目录，不需要外部服务。

dsh-skill-manage gives DSH agents a skill_manage tool for creating, updating, listing, disabling, pinning, and deleting reusable skills. Skills use user or project storage and are hot-loaded by the host. Deletion checks ownership and pin state.
想把验证过的工作流程保存成以后还能调用的 DSH 技能。
能不能让 agent 在当前会话里创建并马上使用新的技能？
我想修改或补丁更新已有的 SKILL.md，不想重写整份文件。
如何暂时隐藏某个技能，之后还能重新启用？
想给技能添加参考资料文件，并查看用户级和项目级技能。
I want my agent to save a proven workflow as a reusable skill.
Can I manage DSH skills during a session without restarting?
I need to list, update, pin, or temporarily disable my saved skills.
dsh-skill-manage 的功能「创建技能」：校验技能名称、YAML frontmatter 和内容长度后创建 SKILL.md，并补入 agent 创建标记；写入后可由宿主热加载。
dsh-skill-manage 的功能「修改技能」：可用唯一文本补丁更新主文件或允许目录中的辅助文件，也可完整重写 SKILL.md；主文件修改会再次校验 frontmatter 和名称。
dsh-skill-manage 的功能「管理启用与固定状态」：disable/enable 切换模型调用标记，pin/unpin 切换固定标记；这些操作保留技能其余内容。
dsh-skill-manage 的功能「列出和删除技能」：list 汇总用户与项目范围的技能及其状态；delete 会检查 agent 创建标记、固定状态和目录位置后再删除。
dsh-skill-manage 会在本机用户技能目录或项目根目录下的 .dsh/skills 中创建、改写和删除技能文件；用户级目录由 DSH_HOME 指定，未设置时使用主目录下的 .dsh。

A [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives the agent **procedural memory**: a `skill_manage` tool for authoring its own skills — create, patch, disable, delete — with layered delete guards. Built on `skill-filesystem`'s hot-reload watcher, so a skill created mid-session is usable in the same session, no restart.

dsh-skill-manage README · dsh-skill-manage：Pair with [`dsh-auto-memory`](https://github.com/Aik358/dsh-auto-memory) for declarative memory: that one remembers *facts* (logs, notes, preferences), this one remembers *how to do things* (workflows, pitfalls, procedures).
dsh-skill-manage README · What it adds：**`skill_manage` tool** — actions: `create` / `patch` / `edit` / `delete` / `disable` / `enable` / `pin` / `unpin` / `write_file` / `remove_file` / `list`

dsh-skill-manage README · What it adds：- **Two scopes** — `scope: 'user'` (default, `~/.dsh/skills`, all workspaces) or `scope: 'project'` (`<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills`, this workspace only). The project root is resolved exactly like the harness's own skill lookup: walk up from the session cwd to the nearest `.git`, falling back to the cwd itself. `list` shows both scopes in one table.
- **Both on-disk layouts** — directory skills (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md`, what `create` writes) and single-file skills (`<root>/<name>.md`), matching the two layouts the `skill-filesystem` watcher actually loads. `list` shows a `layout` flag; single-file skills refuse supporting-file actions.
- **Disable/enable (reversible)** — toggles `disable-model-invocation` in SKILL.md frontmatter, the same key the harness's skill catalog filters on (`isModelInvocable`). Disabling hides a skill from the model's catalog without touching its content; enabling restores it. Prefer `disable` over `delete` for seasonal or off-context skills.
- **Pin/unpin (reversible)** — toggles the same `pinned` frontmatter flag the delete guard reads. A pinned skill cannot be deleted by `skill_manage` (patch/edit still allowed); pin

dsh-skill-manage README · Install：**Option A — via `dsh plugin`** (recommended; handles both steps below automatically):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-manage
```

**Option B — manual npm install**, in your DSH profile dir (e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/web`):

```bash
dsh-skill-manage README · 1. add the dependency：npm install dsh-skill-manage        # or: pnpm add dsh-skill-manage

dsh-skill-manage README · 3. restart dsh web：```

The plugin needs no configuration. Log line `[dsh-skill-manage] ready` confirms it loaded.

**From source (local link)** — for development:bash
dsh-skill-manage README · 2. dsh.profile.bundles: append "dsh-skill-manage"：pnpm install

dsh-skill-manage README · Develop & test：```bash
node test.mjs      # guard-level smoke tests (73 cases, sandboxed DSH_HOME)
node loadtest.mjs  # host-shape contract + real round-trip (set DSH_HOME to sandbox it)
```

CI runs both on every push/PR (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`).

dsh-skill-manage README · v0 known limitations：- Nested category dirs (`<root>/<category>/<name>/SKILL.md`) are not listed or operable — the harness watcher does not load them either (it loads only `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` and `<root>/<name>.md`)
- No YAML flow collections in frontmatter (`tags: [a, b]` stays a raw string)
- Project scope assumes one root per session (the session cwd's git root)
